title: An AI Approach to Verified Production Cryptographic Libraries
abstract: arXiv:2608.00965v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Cryptographic code is critical infrastructure that must be correct, yet formally verifying production libraries remains difficult. Existing language-model proof systems solve isolated obligations with specifications and premises already given, leaving production-library verification unresolved.   We present CryptoProver, an AI-based system that synthesizes internal specifications and Verus-checked proofs from high-level API contracts. Without changing executable code, CryptoProver constructs a new independent proof of curve25519-dalek and verifies RustCrypto's previously unverified chacha20 implementation against an RFC 8439 specification. These cryptographic lineages underpin deployed systems including Signal and Shadowsocks; Signal has an estimated 218M global downloads. translated_title: 一种面向已验证生产级密码学库的AI方法
translated_abstract: 密码学代码是必须保证正确性的关键基础设施，然而对生产级库进行形式化验证仍然十分困难。现有的语言模型证明系统只能在规范和前提条件已给定的情况下解决孤立任务，生产级库的验证问题始终悬而未决。我们提出了CryptoProver，这是一个基于AI的系统，能够从高层API契约出发，自动综合出内部规范并生成经Verus检查的证明。在不修改任何可执行代码的情况下，CryptoProver为curve25519-dalek构建了全新的独立证明，并依据RFC 8439规范验证了RustCrypto中此前从未被验证过的chacha20实现。这些密码学代码支撑着包括Signal和Shadowsocks在内的已部署系统，其中Signal的全球下载量估计达2.18亿次。原始开发者报告称，验证curve25519-dalek需要三人历时五个月的专注工作。在给定API契约和一个固定可信库的前提下……（原文在此截断）
tldr: CryptoProver是一种AI系统，能够从高层API契约自动综合内部规范与经Verus验证的形式化证明，在不改动任何代码的情况下，首次以少量人力完成对curve25519-dalek和chacha20等生产级密码学库的独立验证。
